comments.author: @AllyAlbon
comments.text:
We spent the equivalent of $1k on our wedding.  We had it in our back garden when we lived in Australia (We are British) overlooking the outback.  We went for coffee and cake for breakfast, had a celebrant over and a small group of friends and we bought glasses, champagne, strawberries, cream and some sweets.  Decorated the garden. I bought a lovely new green dress, husband got a new shirt!  We didn’t ask for any gifts and most of our family phoned us to say congrats, our parents were a bit relieved we weren’t asking them to fly out to Oz!  We went for a big meal afterwards and our friends covered our food and drink.  I still have strong memories of staggering home afterwards! That was in 2008 and we are still together and very happy!  Being on the same page is so important, when the wedding is just a day that leads to the rest of your life.

…we also bought cheapy wedding rings, and we have both lost ours over the years!  We will one day treat ourselves to proper new ones… but it hasn’t been a high priority!
